tldr: About a dozen of your live ads are wearing out fast because the exact same opening line, body copy, and swipeable format keep repeating. Meta sees these near-identical ads as basically one ad, so it quietly shows just one and stops running the rest.

benchmark.context: The typical brand ships fresh ads about every 3 weeks; the best brands do it every 2 weeks. At your volume you're pushing that limit, but so many of your new ads say the same thing that they age like one old ad.

drivers: This exact body copy is running word-for-word on four other live ads right now.
Meta sees all five as the same ad and only serves one, so the other four burn budget for almost no views.
The headline 'Designed for Kids' says nothing a parent hasn't already read on the last ten scrolls.

ads.headline: Made for Tween Skin, Not Adult Skin.
ads.body: Tween skin is more delicate and sensitive than adult skin, which means it can react quickly to harsh or overly active ingredients. Many everyday products are formulated for mature skin, not developing skin. That's why gentle, age-appropriate care matters. Simple routines with thoughtfully formulated products help support balance, reduce irritation, and build healthy habits from the start 🤍 Because growing skin deserves care that's made for it ✨
drivers: An identical copy-paste of another live ad, same headline word-for-word.
The body is a wall of soft language with no product, no price, and no reason to click today.
Both twins point at the same page, so they compete against each other for the same click.

hero_concept.hook: Two minutes. Before school. That's it.
hero_concept.headline: The After-Shower Face Towel
hero_concept.primary_text:
Every mum knows the morning rush. Toast half-eaten, shoes missing, and a kid at the sink with a soaking-wet face and no idea what to do next.

Our Face Towel is soft enough for a seven-year-old's skin and small enough to live on their hook, not yours. It's the tiny habit that turns 'wash your face' from a fight into a two-minute thing they actually do.

$10 off your first Petite Skin Co. order when you join the Petite Club.
hero_concept.visual_direction: A close overhead shot of the folded Face Towel resting on a soft bathroom counter with morning light through a window, a small drinking glass and toothbrush beside it, warm and lived-in like a real family bathroom.
hero_concept.fills_gap: Almost every ad you have right now leads with a general message about growing skin. None of them make one small, cheap product the star of the story. A single-image ad on one everyday item at a low price gives Meta something totally different to show, and gives new mums an easy first thing to try before the $149 kit.
hero_concept.image_prompt: A photorealistic editorial product photograph featuring the product from the reference image, styled in a soft family-bathroom scene with the folded Face Towel resting on a warm-toned counter beside a small drinking glass and a child's toothbrush, with soft natural morning light streaming through a nearby window casting gentle diffused shadows. Calm, clean, aspirational everyday aesthetic in the same warm off-white and cream palette Petite Skin Co. uses across their existing ads, breathable and airy with a lived-in feel. Square 1:1 composition with breathing room top and bottom for ad text overlay. CRITICAL - preserve the exact fabric color, weave, and finish of the Face Towel as shown in the reference image, including any woven brand label, embroidered logo, or printed text on the towel - strictly NO color shift to pure white or grey, NO changing the weave texture, NO removing or altering any woven label or embroidered detail. STRUCTURE - preserve the exact construction of the Face Towel: same size and proportions, same folded shape as reference, same edge finish (hemmed or looped edging as shown), same corner label or tag placement, same trim if any. Do NOT add fringe, do NOT change the towel from folded to unfolded or vice versa, do NOT add stitching or piping not present in the reference, do NOT remove or reposition the brand label or woven logo, PRESERVE any printed or embroidered text on the towel exactly. Render the product's fabric, color, finish, weave, AND every visible construction detail EXACTLY as they appear in the reference image. Do NOT change the fabric type, do NOT shift the color temperature, do NOT introduce tones not present in the reference, do NOT add or remove trim, labels, or embroidery, do NOT alter the silhouette, do NOT remove or modify printed graphics or text on the towel. IMPORTANT: the 'no text' and 'no logos' items in the NEGATIVE list below apply ONLY to text or logos added as overlay to the photograph itself - text, logos, graphics, prints, and brand labels that exist ON the product in the reference image are part of the product and must be preserved exactly. Premium commerce photography quality. NEGATIVE: no overlay text added to the photograph, no overlay logos added to the photograph, no watermarks, no UI elements, no Facebook interface, no clickable buttons, no faces, no models, no collage, no borders, no duplicate products, no color shift, no fabric swap, no bleaching to pure white, no cool-tone bias, no recoloring of trim or label, no pattern modifications, no removing or replacing the product's woven or printed brand marks, no added stitching not present in reference, no silhouette alterations, no design modifications.
